description: This file defines a PHP class nusoap_fault (and its alias soap_fault) used to represent and serialize SOAP faults in a web services context. It includes properties for fault code, actor, string, and detail, along with a constructor and a method to serialize the fault to XML format.

classes.name: nusoap_fault
classes.description: Represents a SOAP fault with properties for code, actor, string, and detail, capable of serializing itself into SOAP XML format.

classes.name: soap_fault
classes.description: An alias for nusoap_fault for backward compatibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new SOAP fault with the provided code, actor, string, and detail.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the SOAP fault into an XML string representing a SOAP fault message.
